prompt: Add `(*Checkout).Pay(ctx context.Context, cart Cart, code, country, cardToken string) (string, error)` in checkout.go. It applies the coupon `code` from the checkout's coupon book, which must refuse an expired coupon with `ErrCouponExpired`; adds VAT for the customer's country (20% for "GB", 19% for "DE", 21% for "NL", none elsewhere; more countries will follow); charges the result in euros through `StripeClient.CreateCharge` in stripe_client.go; and returns the charge id. We may add PayPal at some point. `BuildCheckout(client *StripeClient) *Checkout` in app.go must return a ready checkout that charges through `client`.
